slides.label: Saturday, 10 AM
slides.idea: Pick one small problem you have, e.g. long college notices nobody reads -> a notice summariser.
slides.title: Your first app doesn't need a big idea.
slides.line: Pick one small problem, like long college notices.

slides.label: Saturday, 2 PM
slides.idea: Get a free Gemini API key in Google AI Studio (free tier).
slides.title: Get a free Gemini API key in AI Studio.
slides.line: It takes a few minutes with your Google account.
slides.screen: Google AI Studio 'API keys' page cropped: 'Create API key' button and one key row masked (AIza••••••••), project name notice-summariser

slides.label: Copy this
slides.idea: Paste this starter prompt into your AI assistant (full prompt in the caption).
slides.title: Here's a faster way: let AI write the code.
slides.line: Paste this prompt and read every line it writes.
slides.screen: An AI chat input box containing the starter prompt, Send arrow
slides.copy_text: Build a Streamlit app in Python, in one file called app.py. The user pastes a long college notice. Send it to the Gemini API (read the key from st.secrets) and show a 3-line summary and any dates in it. Add clear comments, a requirements.txt, and tell me how to run it locally.

slides.label: Sunday, 11 AM
slides.idea: Deploy it free on Streamlit Community Cloud: push to GitHub, pick the repo, click Deploy.
slides.title: This won't work unless your key stays in Secrets.
slides.line: Deploy on Streamlit Community Cloud and paste the key there.
slides.screen: Streamlit Community Cloud 'Deploy an app' form: Repository aarav-codes/notice-summariser, Branch main, Main file path app.py, Secrets (GEMINI_API_KEY = ••••), Deploy button

slides.label: Screenshot this
slides.idea: Cheat sheet: Sat 10 problem, 2 key, 4 build with prompt, 7 test with 5 real notices; Sun 11 deploy, 2 README + screenshot, 4 share the live link.
slides.title: Your whole weekend fits on one screen.
slides.line: Screenshot it and keep to the times.

images.name: cover
images.prompt: Cinematic night photograph, magazine-ad quality, subtle film grain. A student's wooden desk by a window with distant city lights, lit only by an open laptop's cool glow and a small warm desk lamp; a ceramic mug, a closed notebook and a pen beside the laptop; a pair of hands rests near the keyboard. The desk sits in the lower 60% of the frame; the top 35% is dark, calm window and wall. Portrait 2:3, natural colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.

images.name: s03
images.prompt: Cinematic photograph, magazine-ad quality, the same warm desk-lamp light at night, subtle film grain. A college corridor notice board crowded with pinned paper notices, overlapping sheets and coloured pins (the paper shows only blurred grey lines, nothing readable); a hand holding a phone photographs one notice. Landscape 3:2, subject centred, natural colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.

note: Checked 26 Oct 2026: Gemini API has a Free tier with free tokens on Flash models (ai.google.dev pricing); Streamlit Community Cloud is free for public apps, deploy from GitHub. Daily run: re-check both; don't name a specific Gemini model version on slides. Key stays in Secrets, never in the repo.
